title: b7z9.16.1(a): DAO TX scheduler state on RplStack (join hook + phase/deadline tracking)
description: First slice of b7z9.16.1 (spec 09 14.2 R-09-017..019): add a DAO TX scheduler to RplStack (lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/mod.rs) using dao_timing.rs exports as the single oracle — DaoInitialDelayMin/MaxMs for the 0-2s initial delay after DODAG join, DaoRetryBackoff for the 4/8/16s retry ladder, DaoRefreshTimer for the 900s refresh. State: phase enum (Idle/Initial{deadline_ms}/Retry{attempt, deadline_ms}/Refresh{deadline_ms}) + last sent marker; a join hook (leaf role transition -> schedule Initial with a random 0-2s offset via now_ms) and advance(now_ms). NO TX-path behavior change in this slice (send_dao untouched) — pure state addition, independently landable; (b) wires send_dao to it. Unit tests with a controllable now_ms: join schedules Initial in [0, 2000]ms; advance past deadline -> due; retry ladder advances 4000/8000/16000; refresh at 900s.
